identity_provider.detail: no --auth was given, so this daemon authenticates nobody

agent_events.detail: [gemini reports LIMITED: the session document is rewritten whole on every message and mutated in place afterwards, so this is a sample of state rather than an append-only record read with a durable offset: a session removed by gemini's retention sweep between two polls is never observed]

agent_lineage_observed.detail: joined from the open rollout descriptor while the process is alive, sampled via lsof; a session that ended before it was sampled is never recoverable, because codex writes no pid into a rollout [codex reports UNAVAILABLE: codex writes no pid into a rollout, and its only parent pointers (parent_thread_id, forked_from_id) are codex thread ids, so a codex session started by another vendor's agent cannot be joined to it]

agent_prompts.detail: [gemini reports LIMITED: prompts are read by re-reading a rewritten document, so a session removed between two polls is never observed; a prompt this adapter does see is complete and carries its source record]

filesystem_observed.detail: polled from git status, so it observes net effect rather than every intermediate write; gitignored files and paths outside a repository are not seen

filesystem_reported.detail: derived from agent-reported tool calls, not observed on disk [codex reports LIMITED: derived from applied patches, not observed on disk] [gemini reports LIMITED: file reads the agent reports; no write_file or replace call appears in any observed session, so writes are not observable and none is emitted]

model_calls.detail: [gemini reports LIMITED: a response is withheld until it stops changing, because gemini attaches token usage to a message after writing it, so intermediate states of a turn are never reported]

network_l4.detail: sampled via lsof per agent process subtree; a connection opening and closing between polls is not seen, and no byte counts or durations are measured

network_l7.detail: web search calls the agent volunteers; payload inspection would require terminating TLS and installing a CA in the operator's trust store, which this project will not do [gemini reports UNAVAILABLE: gemini session documents record no network activity; the activity log that would carry it is written only when the cli runs interactively with --debug]

open_files.detail: permanently unavailable: agents open and close files within milliseconds, so sampling cannot observe the descriptor; which files changed is answered by filesystem_observed

process_cwd.detail: agent root processes only, sampled at first sighting and not refreshed

process_liveness_reported.detail: gemini session files record no pid for the agent process; liveness is observable only by the host process collector

process_tree.detail: inline environment assignment values are removed from the recorded command line at capture, and the number removed is reported in command_redactions

sent_dropped.detail: every compaction boundary this adapter reads is recorded exactly, from the vendor's own record and never inferred from an occupancy drop; but a session file untouched for longer than the max-age window is never followed, only the last 4 MiB of a file seen for the first time is read, and eviction inside a context window is not observed at all [codex reports LIMITED: every compaction record this adapter reads is exact and carries the post-compaction input array, and it carries no token count, so none is reported; but a rollout untouched for longer than the max-age window is never followed and only the last 4 MiB of a rollout seen for the first time is read, the summary the conversation was replaced with is stored encrypted and cannot be read, and a bare context_compacted marker with no compacted record beside it is not reported at all] [gemini reports UNAVAILABLE: gemini session documents record no compaction, truncation or eviction boundary of any kind, so context that stopped being sent leaves no trace to read]

subagents.detail: [codex reports LIMITED: spawn and attribution observable; codex reports no subagent completion] [gemini reports UNAVAILABLE: gemini-cli-core records subagent work nowhere: its chat recorder is called only from the main conversation loop, never from the subagent runner]

tailnet_serving.detail: agentd was not started with --tailscale, so it is reachable on loopback only

terminal.detail: terminal attach not implemented before phase 3

tool_calls.detail: [gemini reports LIMITED: read_file and run_shell_command observed; gemini records a tool call only on completion, so an invocation is never seen separately from its result]
